chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Najran from Hamzah ibn Humran from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Like that, and he said: "When you describe the length in it and the width."
ai.seo_question: How should one describe the dimensions of goods when selling them according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific dimensions required for validly describing goods in sales contracts, emphasizing precision to prevent ambiguity (gharar). It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on detailed contractual terms to ensure fairness and transparency in commercial transactions, as recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi's *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*.
